/* ═══════ API ═══════ */
var lastPeriod = null, predData = null, historyNumbers = [4,4,2,5,4,1];
var LOGIC = { 0:{n:5,s:'BIG'},1:{n:2,s:'SMALL'},2:{n:4,s:'SMALL'},3:{n:7,s:'BIG'},4:{n:8,s:'BIG'},5:{n:9,s:'BIG'},6:{n:0,s:'SMALL'},7:{n:3,s:'SMALL'},8:{n:6,s:'BIG'},9:{n:1,s:'SMALL'} };

/* 🔥 Helper: Period +1 (BigInt से safe) */
function incrementPeriod(periodStr) {
  try {
    var str = String(periodStr).trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(str)) return str;
    var len = str.length;
    var num = BigInt(str) + 1n;
    var next = num.toString();
    while (next.length < len) next = "0" + next;
    return next;
  } catch (e) {
    var n = parseInt(periodStr, 10);
    return isNaN(n) ? periodStr : String(n + 1);
  }
}

async function fetchGameResult() {
  try {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const response = await fetch(`https://draw.ar-lottery01.com/WinGo/WinGo_1M/GetHistoryIssuePage.json?ts=${timestamp}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; SM-G991B) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
        "Referer": "https://draw.ar-lottery01.com/",
        "Origin": "https://draw.ar-lottery01.com"
      },
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    if (!response.ok) { console.warn("API status:", response.status); return; }
    const data = await response.json();
    const list = data?.data?.list;
    if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
      historyNumbers = list.slice(0, 6).map(function(item) {
        var num = parseInt(item.number, 10); return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
      });
      renderHistoryBalls(historyNumbers);
      var latestItem = list[0];
      var completedIssue = latestItem.issueNumber ? latestItem.issueNumber.toString() : null;
      
      if (completedIssue) {
        // 🔥 FIX: completed period + 1 = LIVE period
        var liveIssue = incrementPeriod(completedIssue);
        
        var apiIdEl = document.getElementById('apiIdTxt');
        if (apiIdEl) apiIdEl.innerText = liveIssue.slice(-5);
        
        if (liveIssue !== lastPeriod) {
          lastPeriod = liveIssue;
          // Prediction logic के लिए last completed period का last digit
          var lastDigit = parseInt(completedIssue.slice(-1), 10);
          predData = LOGIC[lastDigit] || { n: 4, s: 'SMALL' };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("API error:", e); }
}
function renderHistoryBalls(numsArr) {
  var container = document.getElementById('historyBallsRow');
  if (!container) return;
  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    var n = (numsArr[i] !== undefined && numsArr[i] >= 0 && numsArr[i] <= 9) ? numsArr[i] : 0;
    html += '<div class="hist-ball-item"><img src="' + numberImages[n] + '" alt="' + n + '" onerror="this.src=\'' + numberFallback[n] + '\'"></div>';
  }
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

function switchView(viewName) {
  Object.keys(views).forEach(k => { if(views[k]) views[k].classList.remove('active'); });
  Object.keys(btns).forEach(k => { if(btns[k]) btns[k].style.display = 'none'; });

function updateUI() {
  if (bypassRunning) return;
  if (curState === 'wait') { switchView('auth'); return; }
  if (curState === 'home') { switchView('home'); return; }
  if (curState === 'low')  { switchView('deposit'); return; }
  
  if (curState === 'wingo') {
    if (hasRegisteredLocally) {
      if (fbDepositCondition && lastBalance >= 0 && lastBalance < fbMinDeposit) {
        curState = 'low';
        switchView('deposit');
        return;
      }
      if (wingoHackDone && lockedPrediction) {
        renderResult(lockedPrediction);
        switchView('result');
      } else {
        switchView('ready');
      }
    } else {
      curState = 'wait';
      switchView('auth');
    }
    return;
  }
}

window.setState = function(name) {

  else if (name === 'low') {
    hideWarnOverlay(); warnActive = false;
    bypassRunning = false; curState = 'low'; updateUI();
  }

    if (bypassRunning) return;
    if (curState !== 'wingo') wingoHackDone = false;
    curState = 'wingo'; updateUI();
  }
};

function renderResult(pred) {
  var sizeEl = document.getElementById('resSize'); if (sizeEl) sizeEl.innerText = pred.s;
  var singleImg = document.getElementById('predSingleBallImg');
  var numIndex = parseInt(pred.n, 10);
  if (singleImg && !isNaN(numIndex) && numberImages[numIndex]) {

    singleImg.onerror = function() { this.src = numberFallback[numIndex]; };
  }
  if (lastPeriod) { var apiIdEl = document.getElementById('apiIdTxt'); if (apiIdEl) apiIdEl.innerText = lastPeriod.toString().slice(-5); }
  renderHistoryBalls(historyNumbers);
}

function runBypass() {
  if (bypassRunning) return;
  if (!hasRegisteredLocally || !currentPhone) { window.setState('wait'); return; }
  if (fbDepositCondition && (lastBalance < 0 || lastBalance < fbMinDeposit)) {

  switchView('scan');
  fetchGameResult();
  setTimeout(function() {

    var finalPred;
    if (lockedPeriod && lockedPeriod === lastPeriod && lockedPrediction) {
      finalPred = lockedPrediction;
    } else {
      var lg = predData || LOGIC[Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)];
      predData = lg; finalPred = lg; lockedPeriod = lastPeriod; lockedPrediction = finalPred;
    }
    curState = 'wingo'; updateUI();
    playAudioDirect(finalPred.s === 'BIG' ? 'big.mp3' : 'small.mp3');
  }, 2000);
}

var isDragging = false, dragTarget = null, dragStartX = 0, dragStartY = 0, initialL = 0, initialT = 0, hasMoved = false;

function getClientPos(e) {
  if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) return { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
  if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length > 0) return { x: e.changedTouches[0].clientX, y: e.changedTouches[0].clientY };
  return { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
}
function startDrag(e, target) {
  if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('.btn-container')) return;
  var pos = getClientPos(e);
  isDragging = true; dragTarget = target; hasMoved = false;
  dragStartX = pos.x; dragStartY = pos.y;
  var el = target === 'mini' ? miniBtn : panel;
  var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  initialL = r.left; initialT = r.top;
}
function moveDrag(e) {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  var pos = getClientPos(e);
  var dx = pos.x - dragStartX; var dy = pos.y - dragStartY;
  if (Math.abs(dx) > 5 || Math.abs(dy) > 5) hasMoved = true;
  var el = dragTarget === 'mini' ? miniBtn : panel;
  var w = el.offsetWidth; var h = el.offsetHeight;
  var nL = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - w, initialL + dx));
  var nT = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - h, initialT + dy));
  if (dragTarget === 'mini') {
    el.style.left = nL + 'px'; el.style.top = nT + 'px';
    el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
  } else {
    el.style.left = nL + 'px'; el.style.top = nT + 'px';
    el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto';
    el.style.transform = 'none';
  }
  reportArea();
  if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
}
function endDrag(e) {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  isDragging = false;
  if (!hasMoved && dragTarget === 'mini') openPanelAnimated(e);
  dragTarget = null;
  reportArea();
}
